data.name: Sample_Description
data.value: 선택한 비트맵에 태그를 추가하는 한 번 실행 도구입니다.
data.comment: Sample Plugin catalog description; the tool edits beatmap metadata tags. Keep the tool name Sample Plugin unchanged.

data.name: Sample_SearchTerms
data.comment: Additional Sample Plugin discovery keywords; vertical bars separate searchable terms, and canonical English keywords are retained separately.

data.name: Sample_Help
data.value: Mapping Tools에서 선택한 비트맵에 설정한 태그를 추가합니다. QuickRun은 셸의 현재 비트맵을 사용하며, 편집이 성공하면 osu!를 다시 불러옵니다.
data.comment: Tool-header explanation for the sample metadata-tagging plugin. Preserve Mapping Tools, QuickRun and osu!; distinguish shell-selected maps from the editor map.

data.name: Sample_Tag
data.comment: Field label for a single metadata search tag appended to selected beatmaps.

data.name: Sample_TagHelp
data.value: 선택한 비트맵에 추가할 공백 없는 태그입니다.
data.comment: Tag-field tooltip; whitespace is forbidden because each tag must be one token.

data.name: Sample_TagRequired
data.comment: Required-field validation for an empty metadata tag.

data.name: Sample_TagWhitespace
data.comment: Validation rejecting whitespace within a metadata tag; actual regular-expression syntax is not translated.

data.name: Sample_UpdatingBeatmaps
data.comment: Progress stage while adding a metadata tag to maps; no filenames or percentages are embedded.

data.name: Sample_AlreadyTaggedOne
data.comment: No-change result for one selected beatmap. {0} is the user-authored tag and must remain verbatim.

data.name: Sample_AlreadyTaggedMany
data.comment: No-change result for multiple selected beatmaps. {0} is the user-authored tag and must remain verbatim.

data.name: Sample_TaggedOne
data.comment: Result for exactly one selected beatmap. {0} is the verbatim user tag; {1} is the integer count changed; {2} is the integer count selected (one).

data.name: Sample_TaggedMany
data.comment: Result for multiple selected beatmaps. {0} is the verbatim user tag; {1} is the integer count changed; {2} is the integer count selected.
